quote.text: An institution is the lengthened shadow of one man; as Monachism, of the hermit Antony…
quote.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson, “Self-Reliance”, Essays: First Series (1841). Read at source in the Project Gutenberg text.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia’s chief executive, effective immediately
stories.dek: Colette Kress, the finance chief, takes the job on an interim basis and Harvey Jones becomes Nvidia’s first board chair. More than US$740bn of market value has gone since Friday’s close.

stories.headline: Wyden and Neal investigate the tariff on Nvidia’s China chip sales
stories.dek: The two ranking Democrats call the 25 per cent levy “what appears to be an unconstitutional export tax system”, and say Commerce suspended a Megaspeed inquiry after Nvidia’s outreach.

stories.headline: Japan is evicting the school club from the school, and Kobe went first
stories.dek: A six-year statutory period began in April 2026. On 1 September Kobe replaced about 1,100 school clubs with 1,007 licensed private ones; families there now pay about ¥3,200 a month.

stories.headline: Singapore bars Alice Huang from re-entry and says Washington gave little help
stories.dek: The Ministry of Home Affairs says the police found insufficient evidence of an offence, returned her passport on 26 February and issued a stern warning. Four parties have been charged since February 2025.

stories.headline: Oigen sells a bare-iron tetsubin at ¥22,000; Suzuki Morihisa delivers in 2028
stories.dek: The sixteenth-generation Morihisa kettle is ¥220,000 and ships between August 2027 and February 2028. A glossy lining inside means you have bought a teapot, not a kettle.

stories.headline: Samsung opened pre-orders for its display-free Intelligent Eyewear at US$395
stories.dek: The glasses ship on 10 December in America and South Korea only. Warby Parker’s progressive lenses add US$330, which makes the real price for a reader in reading glasses US$725.

stories.headline: Casio puts a mother-of-pearl dial on the titanium Oceanus Manta at ¥236,500
stories.dek: The reference is OCW-S7000PW-7AJF, 42.8mm and 83 grams, on sale in Japan this month and nowhere else. An exporter is already listing it ¥22,367 below Japanese retail.

stories.headline: U2 release Carnaval de Luz, closing with Dolly Parton’s last recorded vocal
stories.dek: The twelve-track album, the band’s first in nine years, is out today on Island Records. Parton died on 25 August, aged 80; “Torn” was cut in June.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · A Hundred Per Cent
stories.headline: Futures price the Fed at 100 per cent for a December rise
stories.dek: The argument has moved from whether the Federal Reserve raises on 9 December to by how much: 88.3 per cent for a quarter point, 11.7 for a half, nothing at all for a hold. Gold fell 2.80 per cent the same day.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Fifteen Years Of Ten-To-Fifteens
stories.headline: Emotional problems among British 10- to 15-year-olds rose from 11.4 to 27.1 per cent
stories.dek: The European Journal of Epidemiology published the fifteen-year trend on 11 November, from 16,356 children. Over the same years conduct problems fell, from 13.6 per cent to 11.4.

stories.headline: A television tuner, the RTL2832U, gave amateurs a cheap spectrum analyser
stories.dek: The entry dongle costs US$37.95 and receives from about 500 kilohertz to 1.75 gigahertz. The hobby’s own catalogue lists 594 identified signals — and 408 nobody has named.

stories.headline: Lifting kept 1.09kg more lean tissue on tirzepatide, a Perth trial finds
stories.dek: The 120-person T-REx trial appeared in Nature Medicine on 9 November. Both arms lost about 22kg; the other main outcome, fat mass, came back null at P=0.416.

stories.headline: Gardens by the Bay finally prices Christmas Wonderland, from S$9 an adult
stories.dek: Seven issues of asking ends in a three-band table: S$9 off-peak against S$16 same-day at super peak, and S$7 flat for a child. Sumo tickets open on 5 December.
